description: A merge request: a source ref asking to land in a target ref, with what a person wrote about it. Its state is deliberately NOT here — a review is a new `ing.lexicon.git.mergeRequest.state` record, so the history of what happened to the request is the log rather than a field somebody overwrote, exactly as the tracker's issues work.

repoId.description: The repo's identity: a name can be reused, this cannot.

target.description: The ref it asks to land in: `refs/heads/main`.
